rows.jyutping: daa2 din6 waa6 go2 go3 jan4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to refer to the person who made a phone call.

example.english: I asked the caller when they would call back.
example.traditional: 我問咗打電話嗰個人幾時再打嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 man6 zo2 daa2 din6 waa6 go2 go3 jan4 gei2 si4 zoi3 daa2 lai4
